(2) If keep, assign the event to the RIGHT story: an existing candidate story id if it belongs there (this FIXES mechanical clustering — e.g. different outlets' Patch Tuesday roundups are ONE story), or NEW with a clean story_title. (3) merges: list candidate stories that are really the same story (from = fragment, into = the most complete one).
